description: Change the daily budget of up to 20 ad squads at once: mode 'set' (same value for all) or 'scale' (multiply each, e.g. 0.5 = half). Every item keeps the single-item guards (absolute limit, max +100% per step and per 24 hours, minimum budget). Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

name: snap_bulk_set_budget
